projects.name: SimNet
projects.description: SimNet Put iOS Simulators into Airplane Mode or onto a slow, lossy network, see the traffic their apps send, and record what happens on screen, all without touching your Mac's own connection. SimNet is a macOS menu bar app with a matching command-line tool. It uses a network system extension that acts only on connections opened by iOS Simulators, so Safari, Slack, Xcode and everything else on your Mac keep their normal network.

projects.name: Dev Status Check
projects.description:
Is it your code, or is GitHub down? Dev Status checks the status pages of 40+ services developers depend on and puts them in one list, so you can find out in seconds.



Subscribe to the services you rely on, and Dev Status will alert you when one reports a problem, goes into maintenance, or comes back up. Add a widget and you'll see trouble on your Home Screen before you go looking for it.

ALERTS
Only the services you subscribe to send notifications. If all you care about is GitHub Actions and TestFlight, you won't hear about a Zoom outage.

WIDGETS
Small, medium, and large widgets list your subscribed services with the worst problems at the top. When they don't all fit, rows shrink to make room and the widget tells you how many it couldn't show. Tap one to open that service in the app.

THE FULL LIST
Every provider has its own section. Collapsed, it still shows the worst status inside and how many services have problems. Filter down to issues or maintenance, or search for the service you're after. The provider's latest update appears right under each service, and scheduled maintenance shows its start and end times.

Red is an issue, orange is maintenance in progress, yellow is maintenance coming up, and green means it's working.

Refresh any time, or let the app refresh itself.

NO ACCOUNTS, NO TRACKING
There are no ads, analytics, or third-party SDKs, and nothing to sign up for. Dev Status reads each provider's public status page directly, and alerts are created on your device, not pushed from a server.

Dev Status is an independent app and isn't affiliated with any other company.
